terumo_ultimaster_nagomi_des.device_type: coronary DES (sirolimus-eluting, bioresorbable abluminal polymer, CoCr L605, 80 um struts)
terumo_ultimaster_nagomi_des.generation_notes: Latest generation of the Ultimaster family (Ultimaster -> Ultimaster Tansei -> Ultimaster Nagomi). Nagomi adds 2.00 and 4.50 mm diameters and 44/50 mm lengths. Duplicate inventory entry terumo_ultimaster_nagomi (hospital_2, ~100 boxes) is the same product; treat as one family.

sizes.matrix_notes: Full 8 x 11 matrix (every diameter in every length) per the Terumo Europe ordering table. Availability varies by region/market (source says so, no per-market list). Post-dilation limits: 3.50 mm (2.00-2.50), 4.50 mm (2.75-3.00), 6.25 mm (3.50-4.50). Stent: CoCr L605, 80 um struts, sirolimus 3.9 ug/mm. Delivery balloon NP 11 atm, RBP 16 atm.
sizes.other: Usable length 144 cm, rapid exchange, 0.014 in wire; 5 Fr guide for 2.00-4.00, 6 Fr for 4.50; distal shaft 2.7 Fr, proximal 2.0 Fr.

terumo_ultimaster_nagomi_des.ref_scheme: DE-RS + 2-digit diameter code (20,22,25,27,30,35,40,45) + 2-digit length + ASM. Example: DE-RS2733ASM = 2.75 x 33.

carton.basis: not found: no GUDID/EUDAMED/tender/distributor figure located. Inventory measurement 16 x 250 x 295 (own shelf) stands as the only value.

Spine/side seen edge-on: green band with white italic 'Ultimaster Nagomi' left, red/green TERUMO logo right on pale band; seller image, no readable size

terumo_ultimaster_nagomi_des.inventory_corrections: No brand error. terumo_ultimaster_nagomi (inventory_b) is the same family. Front face is pale grey-green with the TERUMO logo top-left, wordmark centred upper third.

terumo_accuforce_nc.device_type: coronary NC (non-compliant) PTCA balloon, rapid exchange
terumo_accuforce_nc.generation_notes: Current-generation Terumo NC balloon (triple-layer, RBP 22 atm; replaces the older Takeru NC / Hiryu NC line).

sizes.matrix_notes: 6 and 8 mm lengths in all diameters; 12, 15, 20 in all diameters (4.5 and 5.0 only 6/8/12/15); 25 and 30 mm only for 2.50, 3.00, 3.50. Nominal 12 atm; RBP 22 atm (2.0-4.0), 20 atm (4.5, 5.0). 6/8 mm lengths and 4.5/5.0 diameters are uncoated.
sizes.other: RX, 0.014 in wire, entry profile 0.43 mm, shaft 1.9/2.5/2.6 Fr, 5 Fr guide (6 Fr for kissing/large).

terumo_accuforce_nc.ref_scheme: DC-RM + 4 digits (diameter x100 first two, length) + HSW (6/8 mm lengths: HSW; 12+: HHW; 4.5/5.0 x12/15: HSW). Example DC-RM2512HHW = 2.5 x 12.

carton.basis: not found. Inventory measurement 16 x 220 x 250 (own shelf) is the only value.

terumo_accuforce_nc.inventory_corrections: Brand/type correct (NC). Inventory REFs DC-RM2612HHW and DC-RM3615HHW do not match the published code pattern (2.5 -> DC-RM25xx, 3.5 -> DC-RM35xx); likely misread 5->6, i.e. DC-RM2512HHW and DC-RM3515HHW. Photo of a real stack reads DC-RM2515HHW for 2.5x15 (blurry).

terumo_ryurei_balloon.device_type: coronary semi-compliant PTCA balloon, rapid exchange
terumo_ryurei_balloon.generation_notes: Current Terumo SC coronary balloon (successor to Hiryu / Tazuna lines); Accuforce is the NC sibling.

sizes.other: 0.014 in wire; entry profile 0.41 mm (<=1.5) / 0.43 mm; shaft 1.9 Fr proximal, 2.4-2.7 / 2.6 Fr distal; single marker for <=1.5 mm, double otherwise.

terumo_heartrail_ii_guiding_catheter.device_type: PTCA guiding catheter (PTFE liner, flat braid, Zone technology)
terumo_heartrail_ii_guiding_catheter.generation_notes: Heartrail II is the established line (Heartrail III exists in some markets, e.g. Ikari/Tiger). Radial-optimised Ikari and Tiger curves.

sizes.matrix_notes: French 5, 6, 7 (ID 1.50/1.80/2.06 mm). Curves (2016 Terumo EU catalogue): AL-1/2/3, AR-1/2, JL-3.0..6.0, JR-3.0..6.0, BL-2.5..4.5, BR-3.5/4.0, MPA-L, IMA-1.0, BP-L, BP-R, IL-3.0/3.5/4.0/4.5, IR-1.0/1.5/2.0, Tiger TR-5.0, ER4 (Catarina), VDR-L; not every curve in every French size (e.g. 3.0 and 2.5 curves 6 Fr only). 5-in-6 system: 5 Fr x 120 cm straight inner catheter.
sizes.other: Usable length 100 cm; 120 cm only for the 5-in-6 inner catheter. Side-hole variants exist.

terumo_heartrail_ii_guiding_catheter.ref_scheme: EU: GC-K + French digit + curve code + 3 digits + N (e.g. GC-K6JR350N). Inventory shows GC-F prefix (e.g. GC-F6JR350N), a regional (likely Asia/Japan) variant; same pattern. JR350 = JR 3.5, 100 cm, no side holes.

carton.basis: not found. A 100 cm catheter is coiled/hooped, so the box is not 1 m long; inventory estimate of ~1000+ mm spine length is almost certainly wrong and should be re-estimated from the photo (box face ~130-150 mm wide). Unverified: a surplus listing mentions 6.4 kg for 150x320x430 mm, but that is a shipper, not the unit box.

terumo_heartrail_ii_guiding_catheter.inventory_corrections: Type correct. Spine length estimate (~1000-1100 mm) is based on the assumption that the box is as long as the catheter; guiding catheters ship coiled in a hoop in a flat box, so treat as unverified. No carton images found (IndiaMART shows only the device).

terumo_navicross.device_type: peripheral support catheter (NOT a guidewire; braided stainless shaft, M-coat hydrophilic coating)
terumo_navicross.generation_notes: Current. R2P NaviCross (200 cm, 0.035) is a related product; 0.018 version added ~2021. Not for coronary or cerebral use.

sizes.matrix_notes: Two wire classes: 0.035 in (4 Fr) and 0.018 in (2.6 Fr), each in straight or 30 deg angled tip.
sizes.other: 0.035: 65/90/135/150 cm (+ R2P 200 cm); 0.018: 65/90/135/150 cm; sheath 4 Fr (0.035), 2.6 Fr (0.018); hydrophilic coating 40 cm; 3 markers (1 mm from tip, then 40 and 60 mm); max injection 300 psi for 0.018.

terumo_navicross.ref_scheme: US: NC18/NC35 + length (65,90,13=135,15=150 cm) + 0 (straight) or 1 (angled), e.g. NC35900 / NC18131. Rest of world: WS*NS350G3HM (straight) / WS*NA... (angled) 0.035; PN*NA180N3H (0.018 x 135 angled).

carton.basis: not found. Carton is a long flat box (catheter 90-135 cm coiled in a hoop? inventory saw boxes lying flat, spine ~250 mm).

terumo_navicross.inventory_corrections: Device type should be support catheter, not guidewire/accessory. Image has MMI (Medical Materials Inc.) watermark and a lightened overlay.

ivascular_angiolite_des.ref_scheme: SCCDSRI4150 + 3-digit diameter code + 4... (inventory reads SCCDSRI4150400019 = 4.0 x 19, SCCDSRI4150250029 = 2.5 x 29): SC CDSR I4 150 + diameter (xxx = mm x100) + length (4 digits, zero padded). Likely printed 'SC CDSR 14N 150 400 019' as for the other iVascular coronary REFs. Not published in a source I could open.

ivascular_angiolite_des.inventory_corrections: None. REF scheme parallels Essential Pro (BC DPR14N...), so 'I4' in inventory REFs is probably '14N'.

ivascular_essential_pro_balloon.device_type: coronary DRUG-COATED balloon (paclitaxel 3 ug/mm2, 80% PTX / 20% excipient), rapid exchange
ivascular_essential_pro_balloon.generation_notes: Current generation, launched June 2020; successor to the original Essential DCB.

sizes.other: 0.014 in wire; shaft 2.6 Fr (<=3.0) / 2.7 Fr (>=3.25); 5 Fr sheath (6 Fr kissing); 2 Pt/Ir markers; Hydrax plus coating.

ivascular_essential_pro_balloon.ref_scheme: BC DPR14N 150 + diameter x100 (3 digits) + length (3 digits, e.g. 030). Printed on cartons as BCDPR14N150400030 = 4.0 x 30.

images.shows: Marketing render of the front face: magenta gradient box, 'essential pro' wordmark top, balloon graphic, iVascular logo bottom. Low resolution, slightly perspective

ivascular_essential_pro_balloon.inventory_corrections: MAJOR: Essential Pro is a paclitaxel drug-coated balloon (DCB), not a plain semi-compliant balloon (device_type coronary_balloon_sc is wrong). The inventory REF prefix 'BCDPRI4NI50...' is a misread of 'BCDPR14N150...'. Sizes seen in inventory (2.0-4.0 x 25/30/40 etc.) all exist in the catalogue.

sizes.matrix_notes: 80 and 140 cm shafts: 3-6 mm in all 7 lengths; 7 mm up to 120; 8 and 9 mm up to 80; 10 and 12 mm up to 60. 200 cm shaft: 6-12 mm in 20 mm length only. NP 6-7 atm, RBP 13-16 atm.
sizes.other: Sheath 5 Fr (3-7 mm), 6 Fr (7-12 mm); tip profile 0.036 in.

ivascular_oceanus_35.ref_scheme: BP PC35 + catheter length (080/140/200) + diameter (mm x100, 10 mm = 100, 12 mm = 120... printed as 3-digit e.g. 300, 800, 100, 120) + balloon length (3-digit). Example BP PC35 080 800 040 = 8 mm x 40 mm, 80 cm.
ivascular_oceanus_35.inventory_corrections: None on brand/type. Inventory REF transcriptions are missing digits vs the 15-character scheme (e.g. BPPC3508000040 should be BPPC35080800040 for 8x40 on 80 cm); the sizes listed in the inventory all exist.

ivascular_oceanus_18.generation_notes: Current line, indications iliac to BTK.

sizes.matrix_notes: 2.0-6.0 mm: all 7 lengths; 7.0: up to 120; 8.0: up to 80. NP 7 atm; RBP 16 atm (14 atm at 8 mm).
sizes.other: 100/150 cm shafts for 2.0-4.0 mm (4 Fr); 100/140 cm for 5.0-8.0 mm (5 Fr). Tip 0.019 in; crossing 0.029-0.057 in.

ivascular_oceanus_18.ref_scheme: BP PC18 + shaft length (100/140/150) + diameter x100 (3 digits) + balloon length (3 digits). Example BP PC18 150 400 120 = 4.0 x 120 on 150 cm.
ivascular_oceanus_18.inventory_corrections: Inventory lists 4x120/150, 3x120/150 and 2.5x120/150 etc.; these exist. Note the brochure has a typo (BP PC18 10 250 150) for 2.5x150 on 100 cm.

ivascular_oceanus_14_pro.device_type: PTA balloon, OTW, 0.014 in (small vessel / BTK)

sizes.other: 4 Fr introducer; tip 0.017 in; crossing 0.021-0.033 in.

ivascular_oceanus_14_pro.ref_scheme: BP PC14N + shaft length (100/150) + diameter x100 + balloon length (3 digits). Example BP PC14N 150 400 080 = 4.0 x 80 on 150 cm.
ivascular_oceanus_14_pro.inventory_corrections: None; all inventory sizes (2x40 ... 4x80, 150 cm) exist.
